---
title: Make it your own
subtitle: The Nocturne theme, installed the same way as the Tufte theme.
---

## Add the theme

```sh
smalldocs add rahuldave/smalldocs-nocturne
```

The command installs `_extensions/nocturne/`, with both modes and local fonts.

## Choose it

In `_smalldocs.yml`:

```yaml
theme: nocturne
toc: true
code-copy: true
```

For a `_quarto.yml` built by SmallDocs, put `theme: nocturne` under `smalldocs:`.
The normal SmallDocs navigation control switches between the two color modes.

## With Quarto

```sh
quarto add rahuldave/smalldocs-nocturne
```

```yaml
format:
  nocturne-html:
    toc: true
```

## Editable sources

The [repository](https://github.com/rahuldave/smalldocs-nocturne) contains the full
theme source in `src/`, font files and Bootstrap in `vendor/`, the build scripts,
tests, and these example pages. Run `sh scripts/build.sh` to rebuild the CSS and
Quarto Sass. The compiled files in `_extensions/nocturne/` are committed too, so
installing the theme needs no CSS compiler.

## The design

Midnight ink, warm brass, and a literary serif. Made for focused reading, with a pearl-paper light mode.

All code uses IBM Plex Mono, bundled with the theme. The source and examples
have an MIT license; the fonts retain their SIL Open Font License notices.
